title: Entrepreneurship Development Program for Youth
summary: The Rotary Club of Chembur Mumbai, in association with Arena Solution Pvt.
description:
The Rotary Club of Chembur Mumbai, in association with Arena Solution Pvt. Ltd., organised a 10-day Entrepreneurship Development Program for Youth from 26th October to 6th November 2026.
The program aims to equip 20 young participants with essential entrepreneurial skills, business knowledge and practical guidance to help them explore self-employment and establish their own businesses.
The training covers entrepreneurship fundamentals, business planning, idea development, financial management, marketing strategies and essential skills required to start and manage a successful enterprise.

Through this initiative, the Rotary Club of Chembur Mumbai aims to encourage youth entrepreneurship, promote self-reliance and create opportunities for sustainable livelihoods.

Project Highlights:
- Duration: 10 Days
- Dates: 26 October – 6 November 2026
- Beneficiaries: 20 Youth Participants
- Timing: 10:30 AM – 1:30 PM
location: Shop No. 3, Park Mist (Manshanti) Building, D.L. Vaidya Road, Dadar West, Mumbai – 400028., Maharashtra
